title: Agent substrate: state machine, log, projection, invalidation, reconstruction
note: Each mutation deletes exactly one enforcement point. The suite must fail. A survivor means that check is unprotected -- not that it is redundant. Five of these survived the first run because the tests provoked corruptions that tripped two checks at once; the isolating tests at the end of tests/test_agent_substrate.py fixed that.

mutations.name: M1_no_hash_recompute
mutations.rationale: a record could be edited in place and still verify

mutations.name: M2_no_chain_link_check
mutations.rationale: a record could be spliced in claiming an ancestry it does not have

mutations.name: M3_no_sequence_check
mutations.rationale: seq is what gives the log a total order; wall time cannot

mutations.name: M4_ignore_truncation_witness
mutations.rationale: a prefix of a valid chain is itself a valid chain; only the separate witness can see truncation

mutations.name: M5_allow_unhashed_extra_fields
mutations.rationale: an unhashed field could carry unverified content beside a valid digest

mutations.name: M6_append_onto_broken_chain
mutations.rationale: appending onto a broken chain buries the break under valid records

mutations.name: M7_allow_terminal_escape
mutations.rationale: I2: revoked authority could be resurrected if the edge table ever grows

mutations.name: M8_ignore_missing_edge
mutations.replace: if edge is None and False:
mutations.rationale: any state could reach any other; the transition table would be advisory

mutations.name: M9_ignore_role
mutations.rationale: an automatic SYSTEM actor could promote a claim with no human or agent promoter

mutations.name: M10_allow_self_verification
mutations.rationale: I4: an agent that proposes and verifies has no verification

mutations.name: M11_skip_evidence_requirement
mutations.rationale: I6: missing evidence would be diagnosed as malformed evidence, sending the caller after a value they never supplied

mutations.name: M12_accept_non_digest_evidence
mutations.rationale: I6: evidence could be cited as free text and then changed

mutations.name: M13_promote_without_policy
mutations.find: if req.dst is State.PROMOTED and req.policy_id is None:
mutations.rationale: I5: a promotion with no policy in force cannot be audited against one

mutations.name: M14_ignore_optimistic_concurrency
mutations.find: if expected_revision is not None and cur.revision != expected_revision:
mutations.rationale: concurrent transitions would silently last-writer-win over authority

mutations.name: M15_skip_unknown_action_guard
mutations.find:
except actions.UnknownAction as exc:
            # Re-raised as this store's own error type.
mutations.rationale: the store swallows an action nothing in this package writes and skips the event, so the projection diverges from the log while looking healthy -- the exact failure the FOREIGN/UNKNOWN split was introduced to avoid

mutations.name: M16_load_without_verifying
mutations.rationale: the live projection would be built from a log known to be broken

mutations.name: M17_only_immediate_children
mutations.rationale: staleness would stop one hop out, leaving canonical records resting on invalidated ones

mutations.name: M18_hardcode_invalidatable
mutations.find: return frozenset(e.src for e in EDGES if e.dst is State.STALE)
mutations.rationale: a hand-maintained copy of the transition table drifts from it; this is the exact defect Hypothesis found

mutations.name: M19_apply_unauthorized_transitions
mutations.rationale: replay would apply a transition the state machine forbids, so a forged log entry would reconstruct cleanly

mutations.name: M20_reconstruct_without_verifying
mutations.rationale: differential verification would run against a corrupt log and agree

mutations.name: M21_append_takes_no_writer_lock
mutations.rationale: two concurrent writers both read the same head and both write a record claiming the same seq; the log is corrupted rather than a record being lost, and every later append is refused against the damage

mutations.name: M22_lock_wait_is_unbounded
mutations.rationale: a blocked append becomes indistinguishable from a hang, which is a much worse thing to debug than a named lock holder

mutations.name: M23_lock_descriptor_leaked
mutations.find:
finally:
            # Closing the descriptor releases the flock
mutations.replace:
finally:
            return  # noqa
            # Closing the descriptor releases the flock
mutations.rationale: the descriptor is never closed, so the flock is held for the life of the process and the next writer waits for a holder that has finished

mutations.name: M24_missing_fcntl_appends_unlocked
mutations.find:
if fcntl is None:                       # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX
            raise EventLogError(
mutations.rationale: a platform without advisory locking silently gets the unlocked append that corrupts the chain

mutations.name: M25_task_replay_trusts_the_records_src
mutations.rationale: the SECOND reader stops noticing a forged starting state, so the only remaining detector of that class is the projection that already had the hole

mutations.name: M26_task_replay_applies_unauthorized_records
mutations.find:
out.unauthorized.append(
                    f"seq {ev.seq}: {tid} {cur['state']} -> {p.get('dst')} "
                    f"would be refused today: {exc}")
                # Do NOT apply. Presence in the log is not authority.
                continue
mutations.replace:
out.unauthorized.append(
                    f"seq {ev.seq}: {tid} {cur['state']} -> {p.get('dst')} "
                    f"would be refused today: {exc}")
mutations.rationale: a transition the machine forbids becomes state in the independent replay, so the two readers agree on a history neither should accept

mutations.name: M27_task_replay_drops_the_lease_each_transition
mutations.find:
if dst is TaskState.LEASED:
            cur["lease"] = dict(p["lease"]) if p.get("lease") else None
mutations.replace:
if True:
            cur["lease"] = dict(p["lease"]) if p.get("lease") else None
mutations.rationale: the replay loses the lease at the step after LEASED and then refuses every completion, so it diverges from the live projection on every healthy run

mutations.name: M28_task_replay_keeps_a_finished_tasks_lease
mutations.find: elif dst is TaskState.QUEUED or dst in TASK_TERMINAL:
mutations.rationale: a lease outlives the work it owned, so requeued work is still owned by a worker that finished

mutations.name: M29_task_replay_skips_unknown_actions
mutations.rationale: a record from a newer schema is silently dropped, so the reconstruction is confidently wrong about a history it could not read

mutations.name: M30_task_replay_without_verifying
mutations.rationale: a second opinion about a document that may have been rewritten is not a second opinion; the differential would then compare two readings of tampered bytes

mutations.name: M31_store_replay_trusts_the_records_src
mutations.find: if claimed is not None and claimed != cur.state.value:
mutations.rationale: a forged record.transition picks the state it is validated against, so every edge in the table becomes reachable from wherever the record was actually sitting

mutations.name: M32_store_replay_does_not_reauthorize
mutations.rationale: THE DEFECT: presence in the log becomes authority. One appended line moved a record from UNDER_REVIEW to PROMOTED -- the state carrying canonical authority, reachable only from VERIFIED by I1

mutations.name: M33_store_replay_resolves_archived_evidence
mutations.rationale: replaying a historical transition whose evidence has since been archived becomes a retroactive authority failure, turning an archival policy into corruption

mutations.name: S34_the_reconstruction_takes_the_executor_from_the_payload
mutations.replace:
cur["executed_by"] = p.get("executed_by", cur["executed_by"])
        # cur["executed_by"] is NOT updated here.
mutations.rationale: the second reader goes back underneath the bypass the first one was fixed for, while still looking like an independent check

mutations.name: S35_a_renamed_executor_is_not_an_anomaly
mutations.find: if claimed_by is not None and claimed_by != cur["executed_by"]:
mutations.rationale: the reader stops reporting the field it refuses to apply, so nothing says the record tried
